explainer_content.short_definition: Internet-native maximalist pop where synthetic texture, processed voice, and genre collision become the hook.
explainer_content.history_capsule: SOPHIE, 100 gecs, Charli XCX, A. G. Cook, Dorian Electra, Rina Sawayama, and related artists turn digital excess into pop identity.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains a generation of pop listeners for whom online weirdness, sincerity, club texture, and compression can all belong together.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The production does not hide its artificiality; it turns artificial sound into emotion and attitude.
